requirements.rule: Indennità economica funzionari (Allegato 2/D) — L7 only, six sub-grade variants (Ex 3°/2°/1° Grado, Funz. Senior, Funz. Business, Ass. ex F2) with distinct amounts. Monthly amounts not found in publicly accessible sources (Allegato 2/D not published). Not modelled.
requirements.remediation: Model Allegato 2/D: the indennità economica of the six L7 funzionari sub-grades as role-keyed fixed_allowances on L7 (like IND_PROFILO_J), once the amounts are sourced.

requirements.rule: INPS RATES: the employer and worker INPS rates of the sector (credito) are totals no 2026 INPS or association table confirms: the only component split found is the INPS guide of 2012 and the 2026 totals come from a software house page that does not prove its year. The contributions of every run rest on them.
requirements.remediation: Source the credito rates of 2026 on an INPS or association table, mark the inps block of contribution/2026/credito.json derived, then remove this note.
Verify the value on its primary source and record the provenance; a derivation states its formula and inputs.

requirements.rule: SICKNESS LIMITS NOT MODELLED (art. 44): a chain longer than the 40 months of art. 46 counts all its days; the two more months of the life-saving therapies and the 150-day exclusion of stays over 7 days for the serious illnesses are not applied; the apprentices' 2, 4 or 6 months of the apprenticeship agreement are not applied.
requirements.remediation: Model the life-saving therapy extension, the 150-day stay exclusion of art. 44 c. 2 and the apprentice comporto of the apprenticeship agreement.
